name: Adapter flange and crossover
function: A short component with a different flange size or rating on each face, used to connect two components that do not match, such as a 10K tubing head to a 15K frac stack.

tabs.overview: Double-studded adapters have studs on both faces and no bolt holes; flanged adapters have one flange and one studded face. The bore matches the smaller of the two connections or steps between them.
tabs.engineering: API 6A; the adapter is rated to the lower of its two ratings for the connection it makes, and the assembly above it is rated to its own working pressure.
tabs.safety: A crossover between ratings is where an under-rated wellhead is exposed to treating pressure if a tree saver is not used; the isolation strategy is decided at rig-up.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
